batch: Jacob cycle (Gen 25:19-36), passages cast by scene / operation-web

units.characteristics: barren-prayer; the womb-struggle; the oracle elder-serves-younger; the naming; opposite characters
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Rebekah barren, Isaac PRAYS (atar 25:21); the twins STRUGGLE/crush in the womb (ratsats 25:22), she SEEKS the LORD (darash); the oracle 'two nations... the elder shall SERVE (avad) the younger, the one STRONGER (ammits) than the other' (25:23); Esau/Jacob born and NAMED (qara 25:25-26, Jacob=heel-grasper); the boys GREW (gadal), Esau a hunter who KNOWS (yada) game, Jacob a COMPLETE/quiet man (tam 25:27) - the supplanter interior set at birth

units.characteristics: the birthright bought for stew; Esau despised it
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Esau comes famished from the field; Jacob is BOILING (zid 25:29) stew; the birthright bargained; called Edom (qara 25:30); Jacob GAVE (natan 25:34) bread and lentils and 'Esau DESPISED (bazah) his birthright' - the grasp met by contempt, a single transaction-web

units.characteristics: the promise renewed; the sister-lie repeated; Isaac's fear
units.gist: NARRATIVE - famine; the promise renewed to Isaac (GIVE/BLESS/MULTIPLY, because Abraham KEPT/OBEYED - natan/barakh/ravah/shamar/shama 26:3-5); Isaac FEARS (yare 26:7) and says Rebekah is his SISTER (the fault re-run from Abraham); she is ATTRACTIVE (tov); Abimelech sees, exposure, 'you would have brought GUILT (asham 26:10) on us' - the father's fear-lie in the son

units.characteristics: prosperity and envy; the wells quarrelled and re-named; the oath of peace; Esau's bitter wives
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Isaac GROWS RICH/great (gadal 26:13); the Philistines ENVY (qana 26:14) him; the wells CONTENDED over and re-NAMED (riv/qara 26:20-22), room MADE (rachav); the promise + 'FEAR not' (barakh/yare/ravah 26:24); Abimelech comes, past HATE (sane 26:27) owned, a COVENANT/oath CUT in PEACE (berit/karat/shalom 26:28-31); Esau's Hittite wives a BITTERNESS (morah 26:35) of spirit - strife turned to peace, the wells re-dug

units.characteristics: blind Isaac wills to bless Esau; Jacob obeys his mother into deceit; the blessing seized
units.gist: THE DECEPTION - blind Isaac CALLS Esau to BLESS (barakh) him, that his SOUL (nephesh 27:4) may bless before death; Rebekah HEARS (shama 27:5), schemes; Jacob OBEYS (shama 27:8,13) his mother; the disguise; the BLESSING (barakh/berakhah recurs 27:19-29) SEIZED - 'let peoples SERVE (avad) you... CURSED (arar) be those who curse you' (27:29) - the blessing grasped by deceit

units.characteristics: Isaac trembles; Esau's bitter cry; deceit named; murderous hatred; Jacob sent away
units.gist: THE AFTERMATH - Isaac TREMBLES violently (charad 27:33); Esau's exceedingly BITTER cry (mar 27:34), WEEPS (bakhah 27:38), 'Bless me too!'; the DECEIT named (mirmah 27:35), 'is he not rightly called Jacob? he has SUPPLANTED me' (27:36); the lesser blessing (avad/live 27:40); Esau HATES (satam 27:41) Jacob in his HEART (lev), plots MOURNING (evel); Rebekah - his RAGE (chemah 27:44) will pass - sends Jacob away - grief + murderous wrath

units.characteristics: Isaac blesses and commissions Jacob; Esau's counter-marriage
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Isaac CALLS and BLESSES Jacob (barakh 28:1), 'God Almighty BLESS you and MULTIPLY (ravah 28:3) you... GIVE (natan) you the blessing of Abraham' (berakhah 28:4); Esau SEES the blessing and OBEYS (shama 28:7) - and marries Ishmael's daughter (the rejected son's counter-move) - the blessing of Abraham handed on, and Esau's answering choice

units.characteristics: the ladder dream; the promise to keep; awe; the vow
units.gist: GEM - the fugitive's dream, the ladder; the LORD GIVES (natan 28:13) the land, promises to BLESS (barakh 28:14) all families and to KEEP/GUARD (shamar 28:15) him; Jacob wakes - 'surely the LORD is here and I did not KNOW (yada 28:16)'; AFRAID (yare 28:17) 'how AWESOME this place'; NAMES it Bethel (qara 28:19); the VOW - if God will KEEP (shamar 28:20) me and I come again in PEACE (shalom 28:21)... of all you GIVE I will give a tenth - the fugitive met and vowing

units.characteristics: Rachel at the well; serving for love; the deceiver deceived
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Jacob at the well, WEEPS (bakhah 29:11) at meeting Rachel; Laban HEARS (shama 29:13); the bargain to SERVE (avad 29:15,18) seven years for Rachel, and for LOVE (ahavah 29:20) they SEEM but days; then the DECEPTION - Leah given, 'why have you DECEIVED (ramah 29:25) me?' - the deceiver of Isaac now deceived; SERVE (avad 29:27,30) another seven - love, labour, and the trick turned back

units.characteristics: the unloved and loved wives; the childbearing contest; each son named off a heart-reason
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Leah HATED (sane 29:31,33), the LORD sees her AFFLICTION (oni 29:32); the sons NAMED (qara) each off an interior cry - HEARD (shama), Reuben/Simeon/Levi/Judah PRAISE (yadah 29:35); Rachel ENVIES (qana 30:1), Jacob INCENSED (charah 30:2); the contest through the maids - JUDGED (din 30:6), PREVAILED (yakhol 30:8), REPROACH removed (cherpah 30:23), God REMEMBERED (zakhar 30:22) Rachel; each qara DISTINCT - the rivalry-web read through the birth-namings

units.characteristics: Jacob asks leave; Laban owns he is blessed for Jacob's sake; the wage-bargain; prosperity
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Jacob asks leave, 'GIVE (natan 30:26) my wives... you KNOW (yada) how I SERVED (avad)'; Laban - 'I have learned the LORD has BLESSED (barakh 30:27) me because of you', FAVOUR (chen); 'the LORD has blessed you ABUNDANTLY (rov 30:30)'; the wage of the speckled, the REMOVING (sur 30:32,35) of the flock, the breeding, Jacob prospers - service and the gain that follows

units.characteristics: the sons' envy of the wealth; God says return; Jacob's case to his wives; the secret flight
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Laban's sons resent the WEALTH/glory (kavod 31:1); God says return; Jacob's case to Leah and Rachel - 'I SERVED (avad 31:6) with all my STRENGTH (koach), he changed my wages, God did not let him HARM (ra 31:7) me and GAVE (natan 31:9) me the flock'; the wives - we are RECKONED (chashav 31:15) foreigners, the RICHES (osher 31:16) are ours; the secret flight, Laban's HEART (lev 31:20) stolen (Rachel takes the gods) - grievance and departure

units.characteristics: Laban pursues; God warns him; the search; Jacob's indignant tally of 20 years; the Fear of Isaac; the Mizpah covenant
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Laban pursues; God warns 'say nothing GOOD or BAD' (tov/ra 31:24,29); the search for the gods; Jacob INCENSED (charah 31:36), 'what is my TRANSGRESSION (pesha), my SIN (chattat)?', tallies 20 years' AFFLICTION (oni 31:42) and the FEAR/DREAD of Isaac (pachad); the heap, the COVENANT CUT (berit/karat 31:44), 'the God of Abraham JUDGE (shaphat 31:53) between us', the DREAD of Isaac sworn; parting BLESSING (barakh 31:55) - confrontation into treaty

units.characteristics: angels/Mahanaim; great fear; the prayer of unworthiness; the gift to appease
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the angels, NAMED Mahanaim (qara 32:2); word that Esau comes with 400; Jacob greatly AFRAID (yare 32:7) and distressed; the PRAYER - 'I am not worthy of the least of your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed 32:10) and FAITHFULNESS (emet)... deliver me, I FEAR (yare 32:11) him... you said you would MULTIPLY (rov 32:12) my offspring'; the gift sent ahead to APPEASE/atone (kipper/kaphar 32:20) - dread turned to prayer and provision

units.characteristics: the night wrestling; the blessing seized; the new name Israel; face of God
units.gist: GEM - the night WRESTLING; 'I will not let you go unless you BLESS (barakh 32:26) me'; the new name - 'no longer Jacob but ISRAEL, for you have STRIVEN (sarah 32:28) with God and men and PREVAILED (yakhol)'; Jacob ASKS (shaal 32:29) his name and is BLESSED; NAMES it Peniel (qara 32:30) - 'I have seen God face to face, and my SOUL/life (nephesh) is delivered' - the supplanter renamed, the blessing seized through brokenness

units.characteristics: the dreaded meeting; Esau runs and weeps; grace and the offered blessing; the parting
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the meeting feared; Esau RUNS, embraces, WEEPS (bakhah 33:4); 'God has dealt GRACIOUSLY (chanan 33:5,11) with me... if I have found FAVOUR (chen 33:8,10,15)... ACCEPT (ratsah 33:10) my present... take my BLESSING (berakhah 33:11)'; the courteous parting; Jacob to Succoth/Shechem, builds an altar and CALLS it El-Elohe-Israel (qara 33:20) - fear dissolved into grace and gift

units.characteristics: Dinah humbled; Shechem's soul cleaves; Jacob's silence; the brothers' fury; the deceitful vengeance
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Dinah HUMBLED/afflicted (anah 34:2); Shechem's SOUL (nephesh 34:3) cleaves, speaks to her HEART (lev), his soul LONGS (chashaq 34:8); Jacob HEARS and KEEPS SILENT (charesh 34:5); the sons come in, FURIOUS (charah 34:7), INDIGNANT (atsav), for a FOLLY (nevalah) was done; the DECEITFUL (mirmah 34:13) covenant of circumcision; the city SECURE (betach 34:25) slaughtered; 'should he treat our sister as a PROSTITUTE (zanah 34:31)?' - violation, silence, treacherous vengeance

units.characteristics: purge foreign gods and purify; terror of God guards; the renaming Israel renewed; Rachel's and Isaac's deaths
units.gist: NARRATIVE - back to Bethel; put away foreign gods and PURIFY (taher 35:2), REMOVE (sur); God answered in DISTRESS (tsarah 35:3); the TERROR (chittah 35:5) of God on the cities guards them; God BLESSES (barakh 35:9), renames Israel, 'be fruitful and MULTIPLY (ravah 35:11)'; Rachel dies bearing Ben-oni/Benjamin - 'FEAR not' (yare 35:17), her SOUL (nephesh 35:18) departing, NAMED; Reuben and Bilhah, Israel HEARD (shama 35:22); Isaac dies, gathered - return, consecration, and the register of death

units.characteristics: Esau's genealogy (Edom); the brother's separate nationhood
units.gist: GENEALOGY - the generations of Esau (Edom); the PERSONS/souls (nephesh 36:6) of his household, and the land COULD NOT (yakhol 36:7) bear them both dwelling together, so Esau settled apart - thin inner-being yield, the formula recording the brother's separate nationhood (parallels ABR-18 Ishmael's line)
